messages.author: d72e57e5f1ad8c13
messages.subject: Error in p.adjust(pvals, "BH")
parts:
Command:

myMethylDiff <- calculateDiffMeth(myMethylBase, slim=FALSE, num.cores=3)

Output

Loading required package: methods
Error in p.adjust(pvals, "BH") : 
  (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
Calls: calculateDiffMeth -> calculateDiffMeth -> fix.q.values.glm -> p.adjust
Execution halted

The exact same command works fine with slim=TRUE.
I've tried with R-3.0.3 and R-3.0.2, but get the same error message.
